lines.text: On the first day of the week, Jesus stood among the locked-in disciples and showed them His hands and His side.
Jesus told the disciples that He was sending them, breathed on them, and said to receive the Holy Spirit.
Thomas was absent when Jesus came, and he said he would not believe unless he saw the nail marks and touched His side.
Twelve days later Jesus came again, told Thomas to put his finger in His hands, and Thomas said, "My Lord and my God!"
Jesus said those who have not seen are blessed, and John says these signs are written so that readers may believe and have life.
